as_told.title: 2019 swarms of about 100 UAP, some pyramid-shaped

plain: In 2019, the story goes, swarms of UAP, the official term for unidentified flying objects, flew over US Navy ships off the Channel Islands and the Southern California coast for five or six months. The commentator Marik von Rennenkampff tells Michels this, relaying the reporting of the journalists Jeremy Corbell and George Knapp. Corbell himself says there were about 100 UAP and that some were pyramid-shaped, which would mean unknown objects repeatedly shadowed military vessels.
